s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Wiper Arm Head Cap

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 front wiper arm head caps.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Wiper Arm & Blade Assembly RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the front wiper arm nut and front wiper arm & blade assembly RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Wiper Arm & Blade Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the front wiper arm nut and front wiper arm & blade assembly LH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Hood to Cowl Top Seal

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 7 clips and remove the hood to cowl top seal.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Side Panel Protector NO.1 LH

s2.ptxt: Disengage the pin and remove front side panel protector NO.1 LH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Cowl Top Ventilator Louver LH

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 11 claws and remove the cowl top ventilator louver LH as shown in the illustration.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Side Panel Protector NO.1 RH

s2.ptxt: Disengage the pin and remove front side panel protector NO.1 RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Cowl Top Ventilator Louver RH

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 5 claws and remove the cowl top ventilator louver RH as shown in the illustration.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Inner Rear View Mirror Assembly (Inner Mirror: Normal)

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 2 claws and remove the inner rear view mirror cover.

Push the lock lever in the direction of arrow (1) shown in the illustration to release it, and slide the inner rear view mirror assembly in the direction of arrow (2) shown in the illustration to remove it.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Inner Rear View Mirror Stay Holder Cover (Inner Mirror: EC Mirror)

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 2 claws and slide the inner rear view mirror cover in the direction of the arrow shown in the illustration.
Disengage the 6 claws and remove the inner rear view mirror cover.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Inner Rear View Mirror Assembly (Inner Mirror: EC Mirror)

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the connector.
Using a torx socket wrench (T20), remove the screw.
Slide the inner rear view mirror assembly in the direction of the arrow shown in the illustration and remove it.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Pillar Garnish Corner Piece RH

s2.ptxt: Apply protective tape to the positions shown in the illustration.
Using a thin flat-tip screwdriver wrapped with protective tape, disengage the 5 claws and 2 guides A.
Disengage the 2 guides B and remove the front pillar garnish corner piece RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Pillar Garnish RH

s2.ptxt: Pull the upper part of the garnish in the direction of arrow (1) shown in the illustration to disengage the clip and front pillar garnish clip.
Using nippers or equivalent, cut the front pillar garnish clip.
Pull the garnish in the direction of arrow (2) shown in the illustration, disengage the guide and remove the front pillar garnish RH.
Using a clip remover, remove the front pillar garnish clip from the front pillar RH.

atten3.ptxt: Be sure to replace the installed front pillar garnish clip with a new one.

s2.ptxt: Curtain Shield Airbag Protection

atten3.ptxt: Immediately after removing the front pillar garnish RH, install a protective cover onto the curtain shield airbag.

s3.ptxt: Using cloth or nylon, wrap the airbag portion as shown in the illustration and fix both ends of the cloth or nylon with packing tape.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Pillar Garnish Corner Piece LH

atten4.ptxt: Remove using the same procedure as for the RH side.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Pillar Garnish LH

s2.ptxt: Pull the upper part of the garnish in the direction of arrow (1) shown in the illustration to disengage the 2 clips.
Using nippers or equivalent, cut the front pillar garnish clip.
Pull the garnish in the direction of arrow (2) shown in the illustration, disengage the guide and remove the front pillar garnish LH.
Using a clip remover, remove the front pillar garnish clip from the front pillar LH.

atten3.ptxt: Be sure to replace the installed front pillar garnish clip with a new one.

s2.ptxt: Curtain Shield Airbag Protection

atten3.ptxt: Immediately after removing the front pillar garnish LH, install a protective cover onto the curtain shield airbag.

s3.ptxt: Using cloth or nylon, wrap the airbag portion as shown in the illustration and fix both ends of the cloth or nylon with packing tape.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Opening Trim Weatherstrip RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the front door opening weatherstrip RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Opening Trim Weatherstrip LH

atten4.ptxt: Remove using the same procedure as for the RH side.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Map Light Assembly (w/o Interior Illumination Light)

s2.ptxt: Using a roof molding remover, disengage the 4 claws and 4 clips.
Disconnect each connector and remove the map light assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Interior Illumination Light Assembly NO.1 (w/ Interior Illumination Light)

s2.ptxt: Using a roof molding remover, detach the clips in order from the front.
Detach the harness at the position shown in the illustration from the clamp.
Disconnect the connector and remove interior illumination light assembly NO.1.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Visor Assembly RH

s2.ptxt: Using a roof molding remover, disengage the 4 claws and remove the visor bracket cover.
Disengage the 2 springs and remove the visor assembly RH.
Remove the 2 springs from the vehicle.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Visor Assembly LH

atten4.ptxt: Remove using the same procedure as for the RH side.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Assist Grip

s2.ptxt: Using a clip remover wrapped with protective tape, disengage the 4 claws of the assist grip cover.

atten3.ptxt: Do not pry forcibly, as the assist grip cover may be deformed.

atten4.ptxt: It is sufficient for the assist grip cover to lift slightly as shown in the illustration.

s2.ptxt: Pull out the 2 assist grip covers by hand to remove them.
Disengage the 2 springs and remove the assist grip.
Remove the 2 springs from the vehicle.

atten4.ptxt: Remove the other 3 in the same way.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Room Light Assembly NO.1

s2.ptxt: Using a thin flat-tip screwdriver wrapped with protective tape, pry the cutout of the lens cover to disengage the 4 claws and remove the room light lens.
Disengage the claws.
Disengage the guide and remove the room light cover.

atten4.ptxt: Remove the RH side in the same way.

s2.ptxt: Using a flat-tip screwdriver wrapped with protective tape, push the 2 levers in the direction of the arrow so that the 2 claws A are disengaged.
Disengage the 2 claws B.
Using a thin flat-tip screwdriver, disengage the 4 claws and remove room light assembly No.1 from the room light switch base.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Visor Holder

s2.ptxt: Turn the tip of the visor holder clockwise approximately 45° and pull out the tip of the visor holder.
Disengage the 2 claws and remove the visor holder.

atten4.ptxt: Remove the LH side using the same procedure.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Roof Headlining Assembly

atten4.ptxt: Remove the front part of the roof headlining assembly to the extent needed for windshield glass removal and installation.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Windshield Glass Assembly

item.ptxt: Windshield glass stopper No.1 and windshield glass stopper No.2 are installed at the positions on the windshield glass shown in the illustration, so take care not to damage the windshield glass when cutting.
Use a windshield knife or piano wire as appropriate, depending on the cutting location and conditions.
Because the windshield glass may fall during the work, hold the windshield glass from outside the vehicle using suction cups.

atten4.ptxt: Depending on the vehicle, either a 1 piece type or 2 piece type windshield glass stopper may be installed.

s2.ptxt: Apply protective tape to the body surface around the windshield glass.

atten3.ptxt: When reusing the windshield glass, before removing it, apply packing tape or equivalent to the windshield glass and body panel, and make matchmarks with a pen for installation.

s2.ptxt: Using a utility knife, cut the windshield outside moulding.
Attach suction cups to the windshield glass.
Using a clip remover, disengage the 2 clamps and disconnect the front window deicer connector. (w/ Cold Area Specification)
When using a windshield knife

s3.ptxt: Apply plenty of soapy water to the bonded area.
Insert the windshield knife into the bonded area.

atten3.ptxt: Never pry with the windshield knife.

atten4.ptxt: Start at a location where the gap between the windshield glass and body is wide.

s2.ptxt: When using piano wire

s3.ptxt: Pass piano wire (0.6mm is suitable) through as shown in the illustration, and attach both ends to a mighty puller.
Pull the piano wire alternately to cut the windshield glass adhesive, leaving the windshield glass stoppers.

item.ptxt: Do not let the piano wire contact the edge of the windshield glass strongly.
When working near the curtain shield airbag, be careful not to damage it with the piano wire.
When working near the instrument panel (safety pad), place a plastic protective plate against it so as not to damage it with the piano wire.
Be careful, as the piano wire will break if crossed.

s2.ptxt: Holding the suction cups, disengage the windshield glass stoppers and remove the windshield glass assembly.

atten3.ptxt: Be careful not to drop the windshield glass.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Window Glass Adhesive Dam NO.2

s2.ptxt: Using a scraper, remove the windshield glass adhesive dam. (When reusing windshield glass)

item.ptxt: Do not damage the windshield glass.
Be sure to replace the removed windshield glass adhesive dam with a new one.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Windshield Glass Stopper (Stopper 1-piece Type)

s2.ptxt: Remove the windshield glass stopper. (When reusing windshield glass)

item.ptxt: Do not damage the windshield glass.
Be sure to replace the removed windshield glass stopper with a new one.

atten4.ptxt: When installing the windshield glass, use the 2 piece type windshield glass stopper No.2.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Windshield Glass Stopper NO.2 (Stopper 2-piece Type)

s2.ptxt: Using a scraper, remove windshield glass stopper No.2. (When reusing windshield glass)

item.ptxt: Do not damage the windshield glass.
Be sure to replace the removed windshield glass stopper with a new one.

atten4.ptxt: When installing the windshield glass, use the 2 piece type windshield glass stopper No.2.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Windshield Glass Stopper NO.1 (Stopper 2-piece Type)

s2.ptxt: Remove windshield glass stopper No.1.

atten3.ptxt: Be sure to replace the removed windshield glass stopper with a new one.

atten4.ptxt: When installing the windshield glass, use the 2 piece type windshield glass stopper No.1.
